name: claudex
description: AI-first Claudex session observations, reviewed operations and exact-session receipt handling.

stateRoot.title: Claudex state root
stateRoot.description: Canonical private synchronization root. The stage command supplies this path.

selfWake.title: Enable current-session inbox delivery
selfWake.description: Enable this session for the default mod-self route. Explicit saved false remains off. An owned native child posts into this session's own inbox; native inbound controls and Stop ACK remain authoritative. No other sender or SendMessage tool is required. Never retries refused or uncertain messages.

nativeWake.title: Enable automatic native delivery
nativeWake.description: Deliver wake-enabled broker messages through the selected Mod route. Enabled by default; native replies can consume model allowance. Explicit saved false remains off. Existing Stop hooks retain ACK handling. Unknown outcomes are never resent.
